newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO STOCKS SOAR TO NEW INTRADAY RECORD.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO STOCKS SOAR TO NEW INTRADAY RECORD.

text.p: Mexican stocks sharply extended initial gains in the early minutes of trade on Thursday.
Dealers said share prices had climbed on a flood of foreign buyers for emerging market funds taking refuge from Asia and Brazil.
The leading IPC share index was up 59.68 points, or 1.15 percent, at a new trading record of 5,272.87.
"Foreign investors are weighing in again; they seem unstoppable," a desk trader said.
Trading volume was moderate at 4.7 million shares, but picking up, traders said.
On the broad market, gainers outpaced sliders by 28 to six out of 44 stocks traded.
